t: r/solar on Reddit: Thoughts on Cougar Paws?
s: November 30, 2023 - Just kidding, I'd buy them if they came with a lifetime supply of replacement pads. They burn out pretty quick ... Sizes run big. I prefer comfortable boots with fresh tread on steep pitches and anything below 33 pitch is really walkable and shoes don’t matter too much unless they are no so worn down there is no tread. Definitely have to be care walking in · Cougar Paws though as you can damage the roofs if you swivel pivot quickly and you can wear the bottoms out of you walk too much in them not on the roof.
